versions.changelog:
- Bumped version to 1.0.2.
- Minor update to wording in the "Going further" section for clarity (projects now described as "GTM as Code").
- Removed the skill-card.md file.
- No changes to user-facing functionality or behavior.

- Added an "Example" section with a sample workflow and output table to illustrate usage and credits spent.
- Updated metadata: changed source to "one-off" and added personas for "revops" and "gtm-engineering".
- Removed redundant or less relevant content (file skill-card.md was removed).
- Clarified descriptions and improved organization for better readability.
- No changes to core functionality or CLI usage.

Initial release of waterfall-enrichment skill.

- Enables cascading lookups through multiple data vendors to improve match rates and minimize data loss.
- Powered by Cargo CLI; requires @cargo-ai/cli installation and sign-in.
- Supports batch contact and company enrichment, and email verification, with clear pricing per record.
- Provides guidance for setup, cost discipline, and sampling before running large batches.
- Designed as a standalone slice; recommends using the full Cargo pack (cargo-gtm) for multi-step flows.
- Includes instructions for user-driven GitHub starring as feedback, ensuring ethical engagement.
